description: Leuprolide may decrease the excretion rate of Venlafaxine which could result in a higher serum level.
The risk or severity of adverse effects can be increased when Mestranol is combined with Lepirudin.
The metabolism of Zolmitriptan can be decreased when combined with Peginterferon alfa-2a.
The risk or severity of CNS depression can be increased when Botulinum toxin type B is combined with Sodium oxybate.
The therapeutic efficacy of Lepirudin can be decreased when used in combination with Octylphenoxy polyethoxyethanol.
The serum concentration of Etanercept can be increased when it is combined with Lopinavir.
The metabolism of Caffeine can be increased when combined with Etanercept.
The risk or severity of QTc prolongation can be increased when Leuprolide is combined with Citalopram.
The risk or severity of hypertension can be increased when Desmopressin is combined with Phentermine.
Desmopressin may decrease the antihypertensive activities of Valsartan.
